title: Pathward Announces Participation in Money20/20 USA 2026
summary: Pathward announces that members of its executive team will participate in panel discussions at Money20/20 USA 2026, taking place Oct. 18-21, in Las Vegas, Nevada.
body_markdown:
[Pathward](https://www.pathward.com/) ®, N.A., a national bank focused on financial access, today announced that members of its executive team will participate in panel discussions at[Money20/20 USA 2026](https://us.money2020.com/) , taking place Oct. 18-21, in Las Vegas, Nevada.


Pathward’s Executive Vice President and Chief Information and Operations Officer[Charles Ingram](https://www.pathward.com/about-us/leadership/charles-ingram) will speak on[Sponsor Banking at Scale: Driving Revenue Across the Lifecycle](https://us.money2020.com/agenda/agenda/sponsor-banking-at-scale-driving-revenue-across-the-fintech-lifecycle-e103-74795) on Sunday, Oct. 18, from 9:30 to 10 a.m. PT. Moderated by Ernst & Young and joined by Thread Bank and Hatch Bank, the session will explore defined bank-fintech relationships and how governance, operating models, automation, and data-driven oversight support responsible growth, regulatory confidence, and sustainable revenue.


Pathward’s Chief Customer Officer[Will Sowell](https://www.linkedin.com/in/willsowell/) will join executives from Fiserv and Stripe’s Merchant Acquirer Limited Purpose Bank for[To Buy/Not Buy a Bank: The Great Fintech Debate](https://us.money2020.com/agenda/agenda/to-buynot-buy-a-bank-the-great-fintech-debate-e103-75915) , moderated by TabaPay. The panel will take place on Tuesday, Oct. 20, from 1:45 to 2:10 p.m. PT and will explore the tradeoffs between fintechs operating as banks versus partnering with sponsor banks.
